Defensive back Dijon Lee Jr. #5 of the Alabama Crimson Tide takes the field before the first half of a game against the East Carolina Pirates at Bryant Denny Stadium in Tuscaloosa, Ala., on Sept. 5, 2026. (Getty Images)

Every week, it feels like college football delivers us games that you absolutely can’t miss. Some stand out more than others, but Fanatics is helping you choose a couple of good ones this week. Bet $20 on Tennessee vs. Alabama or BYU vs. Notre Dame using promo code FOXNEWS350 to earn $350 in FanCash.

This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners. If you sign up or place a wager, FOX News may be compensated. This content was created by a team that works independently from the FOX newsroom.

After last week’s game against Georgia, Alabama has no chance to get any rest. The Crimson Tide are now facing Tennessee and have to do it on the road. Alabama dropped to sixth in the nation, and now Tennessee comes in ranked 14th. Both teams have a loss on their record, and both were to top teams in the country.

After winning five straight games to start the year, Alabama couldn’t find a way to get the win against Georgia. This was a back-and-forth battle between the squads, with Georgia striking first, but Alabama going into the locker room up 14-10. It was tied at 17 going into the fourth quarter, but Georgia was a bit more effective on offense, giving them the win. Meanwhile, Tennessee has won their past two games after losing to Texas.

In the mood for a different College Football Playoff preview? Look no further than Notre Dame heading to Utah to take on BYU. The Fighting Irish are 6-0 and the second-ranked team in the country. On the other side, the Cougars come in at 5-0 as the 8th-ranked team. Two top-ten teams are squaring off, and you can’t miss it!

Notre Dame really hasn’t faced any tough competition this year. Only North Carolina even gave them a remotely close game. They beat the Tar Heels by 11 points. Everyone else has lost by 17 or more. BYU has been perfect, but they haven’t been able to demolish some of their tougher competition. In the past two weeks, they beat TCU and Iowa State by seven and 14, respectively.

These two great games, or any other of your choice, will give you $350 in FanCash from a $20 wager using promo code FOXNEWS350 as a new user with Fanatics.
